ASTM D3035.title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply
ASTM D3035.advisory: ASTM D3035 is not permitted in Indian public procurement without mandatory BIS certification under IS 4984:2016 as per DPIIT QCO 2020.

ASTM A36.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
ASTM A36.advisory: Specify IS 2062 Grade E250/E350. ASTM A36 without BIS standard mark violates Steel QCO 2020.

ASTM A615.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars for Concrete Reinforcement
ASTM A615.advisory: Specify IS 1786 Fe 500D/Fe 550D. Citing ASTM A615 alone violates CVC circulars on national standard precedence.

ISO 4427.title: Polyethylene (PE) pipes for water supply
ISO 4427.advisory: IS 4984 is technically aligned with ISO 4427. Indian procurement mandates BIS license on product.

IEC 60076.title: Power Transformers
IEC 60076.advisory: Distribution transformers must comply with IS 1180:2014 and mandatory BEE star rating.

BS 1387.title: Screwed and socketed steel tubes and tubulars
BS 1387.advisory: BS 1387 has been withdrawn internationally. Mandatory IS 1239 applies.

IEC 61111.title: Live working - Electrical insulating matting
IEC 61111.advisory: Indian Electrical Inspectorate strictly enforces IS 15652:2006 over obsolete IS 5424 or foreign IEC standards.
